turns.user: How many 3DCP papers use a viscosity-modifying admixture (VMA)?
turns.text:
I’ll check the database schema, then count distinct 3DCP papers with a VMA entry.
**403 distinct 3DCP papers** in the literature database include a mix component classified as a VMA (`vma_*`). The count is by paper, not by mix, out of 1,176 papers marked as 3DCP studies in that database.

input.sql: SELECT m.material_class, COUNT(DISTINCT p.paper_uid) AS n_papers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.mix_uid) AS n_mixes FROM papers p JOIN mix_components c ON c.paper_uid = p.paper_uid JOIN materials m ON m.material_uid = c.material_uid WHERE p.is_3dcp_study = '1' AND (m.material_class LIKE 'vma_%' OR LOWER(m.name_in_paper) LIKE '%viscosity%modif%' OR LOWER(m.name_in_paper) LIKE '% vma%') GROUP BY m.material_class ORDER BY n_papers DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.material_class LIKE 'vma_%' THEN p.paper_uid END) AS classified_vma_papers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.material_class LIKE 'vma_%' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dosage_reported,''),NULLIF(c.dosage_kg_m3,'')) IS NOT NULL THEN p.paper_uid END) AS quantified_vma_papers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.material_class LIKE 'vma_%' OR LOWER(m.name_in_paper) LIKE '%viscosity%modif%' OR LOWER(m.name_in_paper) LIKE '% vma%' THEN p.paper_uid END) AS broad_vma_papers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.paper_uid) AS all_3dcp_papers FROM papers p LEFT JOIN mix_components c ON c.paper_uid=p.paper_uid LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.material_uid=c.material_uid WHERE p.is_3dcp_study='1'
